traffic.limits: This sample is not boarding, interior or user-driving acceptance. LOD2 retains far actors rather than returning them to boxes.

rooftop.limits: Per successfully loaded template, replace only complete 6–7-box source groups. A failed template leaves its groups on fallback; other successful templates may remain active. High paired captures admit 24 units; they do not establish an independent Ultra48 performance budget.
rooftop.distanceBasis: Distance from camera focus to source architecture cell bounds, not to each HVAC unit. The selected cell shares one LOD; unit limits are split across at most two cells.

broadleaf.sourceScale: Source h / 10; geometry normalized once to 1 m and instance height remains the source h.
broadleaf.limits: Retain original trees outside admission, at High/Balanced, and for all conifers. Tree Ultra0/8 pairs show a visible-detail tradeoff with substantial full-scene RAF cost, not an FPS gain. 65 m is the distance to one source probe; pool count8 may belong to other eligible nearby trees and is not proof the probed tree remains admitted.

conifers.reason: Root actual-canvas visual review found new near conifers have more conspicuous opaque green layers. Original conifer consumer is retained; CPU packaging success does not override visual rejection.

busMetro.inspection: Actual generic WebGL exterior and interior smoke only; one loaded model at a time. No production bus/metro GLB copies.

latestInteriorReview.observed: New cabin cameras show seats, rails, floor and ceiling. Each inspection loads only the interior, without exterior. Night shows the emissive sign but no cabin illumination.

genericInspection.scope: Static model inspection at physical scale in the real city renderer. Interior top views are camera/framing smoke and cannot establish walkable interior quality.

sourceTrafficAppearance.scope: Existing route0 actor; camera follows its live source position for separate baseline and Blender views. Solar clock and traffic run at capture. Camera positions and route phases differ; no matched-phase performance comparison.

measurementLimits: RAF fps/p50/p95 measure the whole scene scheduling cadence, not GPU frame time or the cost of a single asset.
Renderer calls/triangles include scene and multiple render passes.
Traffic phase remains dynamic, including during fixed-camera consumer sweeps; differing LOD counts and full-scene counters are not an identical actor arrangement.
One machine and short runs do not establish cross-device/mobile budgets or sustained thermal stability.
Original new textures remain allocated after switching away from Ultra; zero admitted trees means restored visual slots, not measured VRAM reclamation.
